stonetop.summary: A vain, hypnotic serpent with a simian head that enthralls the weak-willed.

system.concept: A vain, hypnotic serpent with a simian head that enthralls the weak-willed.
system.description: Swyn are great serpents with simian heads and hypnotic eyes. @UUID[Compendium.stonetop.stonetop-journal.JournalEntry.VosjScKksp5B3hsc]{The Green Lords} bred them out of desperation, borrowing secrets from the @UUID[Compendium.stonetop.stonetop-journal.JournalEntry.5Kym1qDHTmM8XUQ6]{Things Below}; they wanted spymasters and saboteurs, and what they got was a race of petty, craven narcissists. Each swyn fancies itself the greatest and most beautiful of beings — but embarrass, defy, or simply bore one and expect to be brutally devoured. @UUID[Compendium.stonetop.stonetop-journal.JournalEntry.Ej5WiMs30baKNXW3]{The Fae} hunt them, and they shun their own kind, but every dozen years some urge drives them all to the ruins of @UUID[Compendium.stonetop.stonetop-journal.JournalEntry.76FKkdtTFxWEGIKQ]{Vor Svetelik} for ostentatious displays and mating rituals.
